units.translation: b. The mast's thinnest and highest part, above which is the top. So, he says, they hauled the sails up to the tip of the mast.
And 'distinctly' means throughout or stretched tight. And 'with pins' means with the pegs along the planking and the ship's sides, on which they bind the ropes of the rigging.
